about: Concrete motifs a brief implies and what draws them. Each theme has keywords (whole words or phrases, accents ignored) and elements that answer three questions: the object, what it emits or reflects, and what frames it. An element is the specific thing to draw, the placeholder it replaces, how to build it, and the catalog shapes, organic presets, object kinds and operations that do it. vixl_reference(brief) returns the matching themes as motifs; vixl_reference('motifs') returns them all.

elements.element: a cup or mug with steam rising from it
elements.instead_of: a plain disc, ring or circle standing in for the drink
elements.draw: shape cup (a mug on its saucer) with shape steam above the rim, about 0.6 of the cup's height and narrower than it; group them and declare object cup, naming body and steam as parts

elements.element: coffee beans or a pastry beside the cup
elements.instead_of: scattered dots
elements.draw: a few beans as shape lens (rotated, two tones) or an organic blob for a bun; three to five, not a pattern

elements.element: a warm window or lamp glow
elements.instead_of: a flat yellow rectangle
elements.draw: haze behind the lamp or window (form round for a lamp, band for a lit window row)

elements.element: filled layered water: bands of sea in three or four tones, lighter at the horizon, darker in front
elements.instead_of: thin stroked wave lines, which read as unfinished next to filled shapes
elements.draw: organic preset water across the lower part of the canvas (width = canvas width; params.tones in the brand's blues back to front, or params.color); it fills its box edge to edge

elements.element: a lighthouse standing in the sea, its base hidden behind the front band of water
elements.instead_of: a tower floating on a bar or platform in mid-air
elements.draw: shape lighthouse placed so its bottom sits inside the water; order it between the back and front water bands (reorder below the front band) so the sea overlaps its base

elements.element: a beam that fades into the distance from the lantern room
elements.instead_of: a hard-edged wedge or visible translucent bands
elements.draw: a pen wedge from the lantern filled with the light colour at about 0.6 opacity, faded along its length with mask action gradient (start white at the lantern, end black far away; direction horizontal, or angled with angle for a tilted beam), plus haze (form round) on the lantern itself

elements.element: lights reflected in the water
elements.instead_of: rows of short dashes
elements.draw: reflection with horizon at the waterline once the scene above it is drawn; re-run it with target after editing the scene

elements.element: morning fog or sea mist drifting over the water and hiding the base of headlands and the lighthouse
elements.instead_of: a flat grey or white overlay, or one uniform band of haze
elements.draw: haze with form fog: three stacked soft bands, lighter and less saturated toward the horizon (layers 2-5, density 0.4-0.6, color the pale blue-grey of the sky at the horizon, seed for the drift), placed behind the nearest headland or the lighthouse with behind so the foreground stays crisp; run it once per gap to put mist between headlands, thinner (lower density) for the farther gap

elements.element: still filled water with a mirrored shoreline
elements.instead_of: an empty flat band or a few wave lines
elements.draw: organic preset water with low amplitude (params.amplitude 0.02, crest false), then reflection of the shoreline, trees or buildings with ripple 0.15 and fade 0.5

elements.element: trees or reeds on the shore
elements.instead_of: green triangles
elements.draw: organic presets pine, tree or grass, smaller and lighter toward the far shore

elements.element: mist lying on the water at dawn, between the shore and the far hills
elements.instead_of: a clear sky meeting a flat band of water, or a white gradient pasted over the hills
elements.draw: haze with form fog at the waterline and over the far shore: two or three soft stacked bands (layers 3, density 0.4-0.5), lighter and less saturated toward the horizon, color a pale tone of the dawn sky; put it behind the nearest trees with behind so the near shore stays sharp, then reflection of the shoreline below it

market.title: Winter, night or holiday market and festivals

elements.element: strings of lights or paper lanterns sagging across the top, each with a glow
elements.instead_of: evenly spaced dots or circles on a straight line
elements.draw: string-lights from one edge to the other with a sag (bulb lantern for a lantern festival, globe for fairy lights; two strings at different depths, the back one smaller)

elements.element: market stalls with striped or scalloped awnings and a warm glow under them
elements.instead_of: plain rectangles
elements.draw: a rectangle stall with a scalloped-border or banner awning, haze (form band) under the awning

elements.element: snowfall or a starry sky that keeps clear of the copy
elements.instead_of: random dots over the text
elements.draw: star-field (white, sparkles 0 for snow) over the sky region; it keeps clear of every text layer by default

elements.element: lights reflected on wet ground or water
elements.instead_of: nothing below the horizon
elements.draw: reflection under the stalls or quay, or bokeh for out-of-focus lights in the foreground

elements.element: a skyline of varied buildings with irregular lit windows
elements.instead_of: a row of equal boxes (a placeholder skyline)
elements.draw: buildings of different widths and heights (rectangle, plus a few house or tower roofs), darker in front; windows as small rectangles repeated with repeat and some removed or dimmed so the pattern is irregular

elements.element: a sky with stars or a glow over the city
elements.instead_of: a flat dark fill
elements.draw: a vertical gradient sky, star-field in the upper part (it avoids the copy), and haze (form band) along the skyline for city glow

elements.element: lights reflected in a river or on wet streets, and out-of-focus lights
elements.instead_of: dashes under each window
elements.draw: reflection with the horizon at the waterline or street edge; bokeh in a foreground corner

elements.element: a moon with a soft halo
elements.instead_of: a flat disc on its own
elements.draw: shape moon or ellipse, with haze (form round) behind it

elements.element: stars of varied size with a few sparkles, thinning toward the horizon
elements.instead_of: evenly spread identical dots, or stars on top of the text
elements.draw: star-field over the sky region (fade 0.5 thins it toward the horizon; it keeps clear of every text layer)

music.title: Concert, open mic or club night

elements.element: a stage light or spotlight glow falling on the subject
elements.instead_of: decorative wave lines filling empty space
elements.draw: haze (form round) above the subject, string-lights across the top for a café or bar venue, bokeh for a crowd of lights

elements.element: a stand microphone
elements.instead_of: a capsule on a stick, or a rounded rectangle standing in for the head
elements.draw: shape microphone: one outline with a slotted grille head, the cradle around it, the stem and the base, about 0.43 as wide as tall; fill it with the lightest tone of the palette on a dark stage, then put haze (form round) behind the head for the spotlight

elements.element: an instrument drawn as an object with its parts
elements.instead_of: a single silhouette with clipped or mismatched parts
elements.draw: build it from parts (the guitar, piano or drum kinds list their parts) and declare it as an object

elements.element: a loaf, croissant or cake drawn as that product, with its crust and cuts
elements.instead_of: a brown circle or a generic wheat icon standing in for the product
elements.draw: a loaf as a capsule in a crust tone with three slanted score marks (shape lens, lighter, rotated about 30 degrees); a croissant as shape crescent with curved segment lines across it; a cupcake as a trapezoid case under a cloud of frosting with a small ellipse on top; two tones per item, the lighter on top

elements.element: steam rising from fresh bread and the warm glow of the oven
elements.instead_of: nothing around the product, or a flat orange rectangle for the oven
elements.draw: shape steam above the loaf at about 0.5 opacity, narrower than the loaf, and haze (form round or band) in a warm tone behind the shelf so the crust catches light

elements.element: a shelf, counter or shop front that frames the product
elements.instead_of: the product floating on an empty background
elements.draw: a counter as a wide rectangle below the product, a striped awning with a scalloped-border edge above it, and a row of loaves of different widths on the shelf (repeat, then vary width and tone)

elements.element: leaves with a midrib and veins on a stem, or a flower with a centre and petals
elements.instead_of: green ovals, or one flat flower icon repeated
elements.draw: shape leaf (a pointed leaf with a stem, its midrib and veins cut out) in two or three greens at different sizes and rotations, grouped on a stem; organic presets leaf, fern, frond or branch for a spray, and flower, daisy, sunflower or rose for blooms, smaller toward the edges

elements.element: morning light and dew on the plants
elements.instead_of: flat, evenly lit foliage
elements.draw: haze (form round) in a warm yellow behind the brightest bloom at low strength, a few small light ellipses on the leaves as dew highlights, and bokeh in the background for sunlit leaves out of focus

elements.element: a pot, a trellis, a wreath or a vine border that holds the plants
elements.instead_of: plants floating on an empty background
elements.draw: a pot as a trapezoid with a rim (rounded-rectangle) in terracotta; a wreath of leaves around the title (shape wreath, or leaves placed around a ring with radial-repeat); organic preset vine along an edge

winter.title: Winter, snow and the holiday season

elements.element: snowflakes with six branched arms, at several sizes
elements.instead_of: white dots or asterisks standing in for snow
elements.draw: shape snowflake (six arms with two pairs of branches each; thickness sets the arm width) in white or ice blue at three sizes, each rotated differently, the small ones at lower opacity; star-field (white, sparkles 0, fade 0) for the fall of small flakes behind them

elements.element: warm light against the cold: lit windows, string lights and a glow on the snow
elements.instead_of: a uniformly cold, flat scene
elements.draw: string-lights across the top or a lit window (a warm rectangle with haze, form band, behind it) against a blue-grey night; reflection of the lights on ice; star-field for the snowfall, which keeps clear of the copy

elements.element: a pine tree, a wreath or a window that holds the scene
elements.instead_of: a triangle on a stick
elements.draw: organic preset pine, smaller toward the horizon, with snow caps as a lighter shape on the branches; a wreath as shape wreath with a ribbon and two berries (small ellipses); a frame shape as the window

elements.element: the ball or equipment of the sport, with the markings that identify it
elements.instead_of: a plain circle standing in for the ball
elements.draw: a football as a white ellipse with a dark pentagon at the centre and short seam lines toward the edge; a basketball as an orange ellipse with four stroked arcs for the seams; a tennis ball with two curved arcs; one ball large and central

elements.element: speed and impact: motion lines and a shadow on the ground
elements.instead_of: a static object with no sense of movement
elements.draw: shape speed-lines or motion-lines trailing behind the ball, a soft shadow under it (a flat ellipse at 0.3 opacity, or look soft-shadow), stadium floodlights as haze (form round) with bokeh in the dark upper corners

elements.element: the field, court or track that places the sport
elements.instead_of: the ball on an empty colour
elements.draw: pitch or court lines as stroked shapes: an outline rectangle, a centre line and a thin centre ring; lane lines for a track (repeat of a long thin rectangle); grass stripes as alternating bands in two greens

elements.element: the product shown as a real device with something on its screen, or a rocket for a launch
elements.instead_of: a grey rectangle, or a generic rocket emoji
elements.draw: shape phone-frame (or tablet-frame, browser-window) with a few interface blocks inside it (rounded rectangles in the brand colours, a small group of chart bars); for a launch, a rocket as a capsule body, a triangle nose, two small triangles for fins and a ring for the window

elements.element: light from the screen or the exhaust, and a reflection on the surface below
elements.instead_of: a device on a flat background with no light
elements.draw: haze (form round) in the accent colour behind the device so the screen seems to glow; reflection with a small horizon under it for a glossy surface; for a launch, an exhaust plume as a vertical gradient (accent to transparent) with a haze at its base

elements.element: a grid, orbit lines or circuit traces that place the product in a system
elements.instead_of: random decorative circles
elements.draw: thin ring shapes as orbits around the product with small ellipses as nodes on them; circuit traces as pen lines with right angles that end in small circles; or a faint dot grid (pattern-scatter) that fades out toward the edges

elements.element: one calm object: a stack of smooth stones, a lotus or a candle
elements.instead_of: an abstract blob, or a stock yoga silhouette
elements.draw: three stones as ellipses of decreasing width stacked with small offsets in two soft tones; or a lotus as five lens petals fanned out with radial-repeat around the base; or a candle as a rounded-rectangle with a teardrop flame

elements.element: a soft glow, steam or sunrise light
elements.instead_of: flat, hard-edged colour
elements.draw: haze (form round) at low strength behind the object, shape steam above a cup of herbal tea, a semicircle sun low behind the stones; keep every edge soft and the contrast gentle

elements.element: generous empty space and one soft shape that holds the object
elements.instead_of: the object crowded by decoration
elements.draw: a large arch or circle in a pale tone behind the object (an ellipse or squircle), leaves from shape leaf at the edges, margins of at least a sixth of the canvas, one line of copy

elements.element: the destination's own landmark, vehicle or luggage
elements.instead_of: a globe or a generic plane that could be any trip
elements.draw: a map-pin standing on the destination; a suitcase as a rounded-rectangle with a handle, two straps and a sticker (shape sticker); a boat, car or bicycle built as an object; for hiking, mountains as layered triangles, darker toward the front

elements.element: the sun's light on the place and what the water reflects
elements.instead_of: a flat sky with nothing under it
elements.draw: shape sun with haze (form round) behind it, a contrail or flight path as a dashed curve (a pen line with dash), and reflection of mountains or buildings in a lake or harbor

elements.element: a ticket, stamp or postcard border that makes it a keepsake
elements.instead_of: a plain photo box
elements.draw: ticket or postmark shapes for passport and booking briefs (a stamp with a circular postmark and a date); a frame or scalloped-border edge for a postcard; a horizon of layered hills for a landscape

elements.element: an open book with lines of text and a visible cover, or a stack of closed books
elements.instead_of: a blank rectangle, or a rectangle with a line down the middle
elements.draw: shape book (two curved pages with a gap at the spine, lines of text cut out and a cover edge under the pages) in one colour; for a stack, three rounded-rectangles of different widths and heights with a lighter band for the pages and a spine stripe, the top one slightly rotated

elements.element: a lamp's warm pool of light on the pages, and dust in the beam
elements.instead_of: a flat page with no light source
elements.draw: haze (form round) in warm yellow above the open book, bokeh (few, small, low opacity) for dust in the beam, and a soft shadow under the book (look soft-shadow)

elements.element: a shelf or window seat that places the reading
elements.instead_of: the book on an empty colour
elements.draw: a shelf of upright books as rectangles of different heights, widths and tones (repeat, then vary), one leaning at an angle, a plant or a lamp at the end; an arched window (a semicircle over a rectangle) behind

elements.element: balloons with a knot and a string, in two or three colours at different heights
elements.instead_of: coloured circles on sticks
elements.draw: shape balloon (a highlight, a knot and a curling string are part of it) in three palette colours at different sizes and heights, each rotated a few degrees one way or the other, strings crossing; one balloon in front, two behind it, smaller

elements.element: confetti, sparkle and the glow of a celebration
elements.instead_of: evenly spaced dots
elements.draw: shape confetti (seeded slips that fill their box) in the brand colours over the top third, a few sparkle shapes in white or yellow beside the balloons, and haze (form round) behind the main balloon; keep the confetti clear of the copy

elements.element: bunting, a banner or a table that sets the scene
elements.instead_of: decorations floating without a place
elements.draw: bunting as a sagging line (a pen curve, or string-lights with bulb pear and no glow) with triangle flags in alternating colours (repeat); a banner shape behind the headline; scalloped-border along the bottom edge
